lines.text: Agree the budget and booking rules, name who handles each reservation, and record who is included so changes do not become everyone's guess.

items.text: Confirm dates and definite participants, with a response deadline for undecided people.
Agree a realistic spending range and which costs remain individual.
Identify essential accessibility, room, transport and dietary arrangements with the traveler's consent.
Give each booking one named handler and a backup contact.
Get explicit agreement before anyone commits other people's money.
Mark activities optional unless the group has agreed otherwise.

line.text: Today shows the current state of the trip in plain sentences, each tracing to something somebody recorded, so the answer is not in your head alone.
